function.name: mailbox_list
function.description: List the letters this agent has filed for its person that are still waiting for an answer, oldest first. Read only.

ax.when: Pick this to see which letters still wait for the person's answer before filing another; it only reads.

errors.means: The call passed an input mailbox_list doesn't take; the text names it.
errors.fix: Call it again with no input; it takes none.
